metadata.title: Pony AI Results Show Just How Big Tesla’s Robo-Taxi Fleet Needs to Get<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Pony AI Results Show Just How Big Tesla’s Robo-Taxi Fleet Needs to Get
Robo-taxis are proliferating around the world, in what amounts to the first widespread physical AI application. Companies including Alphabet and Tesla are racing for robo-taxi dominance, but how good a business they will be remains uncertain.
